programme.title: I was the king – Paweł Brożek | S01E05
programme.desc: A series presenting the profiles of the best scorers in the history of the Premier League. This is a great opportunity to recall the successes of Włodzimierz Lubański, Grzegorz Lata, Kazimierz Kmiecik, Grzegorz Piechna and Tomasz Frankowski. We will get to know different football generations. In the 1960s, Włodzimierz Lubański (Górnik Zabrze) was the top scorer four times in a row. However, in the 1970s, Kazimierz Kmiecik (Wisła Kraków) and Grzegorz Lato (Stal Mielec) reigned supreme. In more modern times, Tomasz Frankowski won four titles in the colors of Wisła Kraków and Jagiellonia Białystok. There will also be the story of Grzegorz Piechna, the unexpected top scorer from Korona Kielce in 2006. Paweł Brożek scored 149 goals in the Polish Ekstraklasa. This places him in eighth place in the all-time ranking of the highest league in our country. His goals contributed to Wisła Kraków winning seven Polish champion titles. Paweł Brożek became the top scorer twice. Poland. 2022-2025. documentary series

programme.title: Lycaons: herd vs. rest of the world 2 – Manzi: superherd | S02E06
programme.desc: Filmmaker and documentarian Julz Braatvedt again visits the charming areas of South Luangwa National Park in Zambia. He observes the everyday life and habits of three herds of wild wild lions and their interactions with other representatives of the local fauna. Viewers will see how the Kakumbi, Manzi and Kakula teams cope with the challenges of Zambian nature. The Kakumbi pack is mourning the loss of two puppies. During the journey to their cave, the camera comes across a hyena lair and lions hunting. Great Britain. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Brotherhood of Lions – The Fat Years | E02
programme.desc: The life story of young lions. The everyday challenges they have to face throughout their adolescence will be shown. The triumphant moments after the hunt will be presented, as well as the dangers to which... Germany is exposed. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Deadly Weather 2 | S02E11
programme.desc: Stories of people who encountered and recorded the most dangerous weather phenomena. Each episode presents blood-curdling footage from witnesses who survived fires, floods, tsunamis, hurricanes, avalanches, snowstorms and maritime disasters. There will also be reports from rescue operations. The most powerful earthquake in a hundred years hits Ecuador. Viewers have the opportunity to listen to the accounts of a family stuck in an apartment and learn the details of the action of a policeman heroically rescuing his friend from the ruins of the hotel. Great Britain. 2018. documentary series

programme.title: Nile: the ultimate river – Life in the desert | E03
programme.desc: Researchers present extraordinary places located in the Nile Delta. They visit, among others: Lake Victoria and the Semien Mountains to look at the local fauna and flora. The Abyssinian Plateau is the cradle of the Blue Nile. Without its waters, the great river would evaporate in the desert before reaching the sea. The Blue Nile flows from Lake Tana in Ethiopia, where the Semien Mountains are located. With steep slopes in the warm rays of the sun and strong updrafts - it is a paradise for birds of prey. The slopes and peaks of the Semien Mountains are home to thousands of vultures. The upper parts of the Blue Nile are inhabited by rare species, such as geladas, close relatives of baboons, and Abyssinian ibexes. Austria. 2014. documentary film

programme.title: Brown hyenas
programme.desc: The documentary focuses on the struggle for survival in the harsh terrain of Botswana. Endangered brown hyenas live there all year round, trying to function normally. Nothing is wasted because hyenas eat whatever they can find. Representatives of this family bring skin, bones and feathers to the cave where the puppies are waiting... South Africa. 2021. documentary film

programme.title: River Monsters 6 – Man-Eating Monster | S06E03
programme.desc: Once again, Jeremy Wade sets off in search of bloodthirsty fish. During his expedition, he visits different parts of the world. He tries to capture dangerous creatures to see if they are actually able to attack people and harm them. Jeremy Wade has been trying to track down the legendary Amazonian giant fish for years. The locals call it lau-lau and say it can swallow a person whole. USA. 2014. documentary series

programme.title: In the Shackles of Frost 4 – There are no shortcuts | S04E12
programme.desc: The fourth season of the documentary story about the fate of the inhabitants of Alaska. Sue Aikens, Jessie Holmes, Glenn Villaneuve and the Hailstones try to survive the harsh winter. For another year in a row, they take up the challenge nature throws at them. The Hailstones are working hard to develop the land they inherited from Agnes' grandparents. Jessie, on the other hand, takes part in a moose hunt. It soon turns out that he is not the only one looking for these deer. Spring is coming. Glenn climbs up. He plans to build a snow cave on it. The Hailstones are pulling a sleigh full of meat to Noorvik. USA. 2014. documentary series

programme.title: Nigel Marven's Wild Central America 2 – Wild Guatemala | S02E03
programme.desc: British actor and zoologist Nigel Marven sets off on a journey to Central American countries to discover the beauty of the local wildlife and the culture of the inhabitants of these areas. Viewers will cross the Darién Isthmus, see the ruins of Mayan cities and stand at the foot of active volcanoes in Guatemala. They will meet unusual animals, including: a giant eagle, colorful quetzals, frog-eating bats, leatherback turtles, royal condors and the most beautiful heron in the world. They will also learn what residents and scientists say about the richness of fauna and flora there. Nigel travels to Guatemala, where he discovers a wealth of wildlife, stunning landscapes and ancient Mayan history. The guide will visit the most beautiful lake in the world, meet the most colorful rattlesnake in Central America and admire the amazing views from the top of the temple in Tikál. He will also learn about multi-colored birds living in cloud forests, poisonous lizards found on land and dangerous crocodiles living in rivers. Great Britain. 2018. documentary series

programme.desc: "How lucky we have been!" A special report that, from the people who have been closest to Rafa Nadal, looks back to remember the unforgettable career of an unrepeatable athlete. The best blows and the most epic victories of the best Spanish athlete of all time. The owner of a legacy that transcends sport and that at the time of his retirement makes us think that how lucky we have been! having enjoyed it

programme.title: How lucky we have been!
programme.desc: «Matchday 19: Atlético Mineiro – Bahía» Football in Brazil is more than a sport, it is a religion. Their league is an inexhaustible factory of players, many of whom emigrate to Europe to succeed. Sao Paulo, Palmeiras, Cruzeiro, Santos and Gremio are the usual contenders for the title

programme.title: Brasileirao (T2026): Atlético Mineiro – Bahía
programme.desc: «Plus+ Report. The… (1): A question of style» After Spain did not qualify for the final phase of the 1992 Euro Cup, the Spanish Football Federation appointed Javier Clemente as national coach. A coach, the one from Barakaldo, who had just won two Leagues with Athletic Bilbao and led Espanyol to the UEFA final. A lover of English football, the new coach puts together a physical and brave team that is the opposite of the beauty of Johan Cruyff's Barça that was beginning to set a trend at that time. Beyond styles and after an agonizing match against Denmark, Spain entered the 1994 World Cup in the United States and for the first time in a long time it is being talked about as one of the favorites to lift the title

programme.title: Plus+ Report. Clemente's Spain (T1): A question of style
programme.desc: «Plus+ Report. The… (1): And the blood reached the river» Javier Clemente's style was not only direct on the field of play. Nor did he avoid clashes in his personal dealings, and on many occasions he sought it out. In the mid-90s, sports journalism in Spain was experiencing one of the wildest periods in memory. A divided country, especially every night on the radio, finds in Clemente's personality the best ammunition to exchange controversies. While the perfect storm is forming, Spain repeats a perfect qualification heading for the 1996 Euro Cup. Never before has an atmosphere been so toxic, rarely has a team played as well as in that summer in England

programme.title: Plus+ Report. Clemente's Spain (S1): And the blood reached the river
programme.desc: «Plus+ Report. The… (1): Six years and one day» For the 1998 World Cup in France, Javier Clemente prepared an improved version of the Spanish team. Without losing its identity of strength and physique, but with more creative profiles like those provided by Raúl, Morientes or Etxeberría. That Spain could go far in the World Cup was something that no one doubted and that may be why the elimination in the first round unleashed the controversy with more force. A Clemente questioned on all sides resists in office thinking that the summer and a new qualifying phase will make it easier to forget. But after the holidays, Cyprus was waiting, a modest amateur team trained by a police officer and captained by a bank worker.

programme.title: Plus+ Report. Clemente's Spain (T1): Six years and one day

programme.title: Bakalá (S25/26): Episode 5
programme.desc: «Universo Valdano (9): Rafa Nadal» For the first time in the history of the program, the protagonist of Universo Valdano will be an athlete who is not a soccer player. Nadal celebrates one year since his retirement on November 19. In this meeting Rafa talks about his first year without tennis, about how an elite and world-class athlete faces leaving what he has been doing for almost his entire life. He also talks about the future and the world of sports. Furthermore, it is curious that Nadal was born on June 3, 1986, just when the 86 World Cup was being held and Valdano was proclaimed world champion with Argentina. An edition of Universo Valdano to enjoy

programme.title: Valdano Universe (S9): Rafa Nadal
programme.desc: «Plus+ Report. Mexico 86 the flight of the Vulture » The World Cup in Mexico 86 brought together bizarre situations for Spain, historic matches and the dream of an almost unthinkable victory. Several members of that generation remember adventures, plays and anecdotes from a competition that exalted Emilio Butragueño and showed the world that Spain was changing. Football was the reflection of a country that that year held its fourth general elections after the dictatorship, that joined the European Economic Community and that learned that Barcelona would be an Olympic champion.

programme.title: Plus+ Report. Mexico 86 the flight of the Vulture
programme.desc: «Plus+ Report. Mexico when Maradona became D10S» The masterpiece of Diego Armando Maradona. The most prodigious individual performance in the history of the soccer World Cup. Writers, journalists and various members of that team led by Carlos Bilardo remember a triumph that was accompanied by constant criticism, historical revenge and internal conflicts. Its protagonists tell us the path that turned a divided group into an unbeatable group.

programme.title: Plus+ Report. Mexico when Maradona became D10S
programme.desc: «Bejaranos. The job of the cyclist» There is a place in Spain, Béjar (Salamanca), where children did not dream of being soccer players, but cyclists. This is the story of passion for cycling in a town that has been the birthplace of some of the best riders in the history of our country.

programme.title: Bejaranos. The cyclist's job
programme.desc: «Plus+ Report. Cucu…Cucurella» European Champion with Spain in July 2024. World Club Champion with Chelsea in the summer of 2025. In those twelve months, Marc Cucurella experienced the success and recognition that he had been fighting for since, at the age of eight, he entered the Espanyol youth team. From there to La Masía, where he could not establish himself in the Barcelona first team. Eibar, Getafe and Brighton were the steps that took Cucurella to Stanford Bridge, where he became the most expensive left-back in the world

programme.title: Plus+ reports. Cuckoo… Cucurella
programme.desc: «Supergarcía: The midnight vigilante» On April 7, 2002, José María García makes his last program without saying goodbye to his listeners. Whoever was his secretary and right-hand man stores thousands of hours of radio and personal objects from García's career in dozens of boxes. Twenty years later, those boxes are opened and García returns to a radio studio to take stock of his career, which began as a young journalist who revolutionized the radio at dawn and soon made him the most listened to, influential and best paid communicator in the country, after his time on TVE, Cadena SER and Antena 3 and with famous coverage such as 23-F or the Vuelta Ciclista a España.

programme.desc: «90 years of LaLiga (2019): Javier Irureta» Jabo Irureta is, after the late Luis Aragonés, the coach with the most games coached in the First Division. From 1984 to 2017 he coached Logroñés, Oviedo, Racing, Athletic Club, Real Sociedad, Celta de Vigo, Deportivo de La Coruña, Betis and Zaragoza for a total of 612 matches played. Irureta achieved success as a player at Atlético de Madrid and Athletic Club and as a coach he entered the living history of Deportivo with the achievement of the League title in the 1999-2000 season and the Copa del Rey trophy in 2002, a match already known historically as the Centenariazo. He also won two Spanish Super Cups with the Galician team.

programme.desc: «Plus+ Report. Maestro Obradovic» Nine-time European champion with five different teams. His passion, intensity and vehemence have marked European basketball for more than thirty years. Zeljko Obradovic was a world champion as a player with a legendary Yugoslav team before making an early move to the bench. It was in 1991, with Partizan Belgrade, the team of his life. His first season he was already European champion. Joventut, Real Madrid, Treviso, Panathinaikos and Fenerbahçe later saw him triumph. Along the way he has marked the lives and careers of hundreds of players. Many call him teacher. Obradovic returned home, to Partizan, where they adore him. And he closed the circle with his resignation in November 2025. In any case, he remains one of the main references of European basketball of all time

programme.title: Plus+ Report. Master Obradovic

programme.title: d/f Open Atlantis
programme.desc: James Cameron and Simcha Jacobovitch embark on an exciting adventure in search of the lost city of Atlantis. Using Plato as a virtual treasure map, they explore various hypotheses for the location of the mythical civilization, including Santorini, Malta and southern Spain. A team of professors from the United States, Canada, Israel and New Zealand analyzes archaeological sites and satellite photographs to determine the most plausible versions. The film also examines theories surrounding Gibraltar and the islands of the Azores archipelago, concluding with an analysis of southwestern Iberia as a potential center of an ancient maritime civilization. This investigation offers viewers a unique opportunity to explore one of the greatest mysteries in human history. USA

programme.desc: 2018 г. Год: 2018. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2018. S1, Ep3 «Wild Latin America»…Get to know South America's only bear species. Witness the shy and charismatic spectacled bear play, forage, and look for mates at the secluded Chaparri Ecological Reserve in Northern PeruThree-part series exploring one of Earth's most unspoiled habitats through the trials and tribulations of three very different species – whales, bears, and squirrel monkeysDirector: Nuala Carr

programme.title: Kalahari, Land of Secret Alliances: Into the Heat (S1 E1). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Prancūzija, 2021. S1, Ep1

Learn of an elephant clan's symbiotic link to fruiting anaboom trees, a meerkat's alliance with a feisty drongo bird, and more flora-and-fauna odd couplesDirector: Pierre StineCast: Virginie Efira

programme.title: Baby Animals: The More the Merrier (S1 E3). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. JAV, 2015. S1, Ep3
programme.desc: 2015 г. Год: 2015. Страна: JAV. Год: 2015. S1, Ep3 «Baby Animals»…Watch fur seals give birth by the thousands, black bear cubs wrestle with their buddies, and meerkat pups forge bonds by sharing chores–all proving that growing up in the animal kingdom is easier when you have numbers on your sideArctic foxes, sea otters, tamarin monkeys and red pandas are just some of the tiniest, cutest creatures featured in Baby Animals. With their big eyes and wobbly first steps, nature's newbies are irresistible. Watch how animals nurture their young as infant elephants, baby bison and rambunctious rhinos all eat, sleep and play their way to adulthood in their respective natural habitats. Cuddly, clumsy and full of mischief, the babies of the animal kingdom certainly make up the wildest daycare you've ever seen. Find out how it all happens

programme.title: Deep Dive: Australia: Tropical Shores (S1 E1). Documentary about nature. England, 2023. S1, Ep1
programme.desc: 2023 г. Год: 2023. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2023. S1, Ep1 «Deep Dive: Australia»…Explore the shores of the Northern Territory and the abundant waters of the Great Barrier Reef. Face flooded roads, hungry saltwater crocs, and killer jellyfish as Lizzie investigates why so many strange, deadly creatures make this remote area homeJoin biologist Lizzie Daly on a road trip along Australia's stunning coastline; spot extreme animals, uncover secrets deep in ancient waters, and meet the human protectors of this biodiversityDirector: Mark WoodwardCast: Lizzie Daly

programme.title: Evolution Earth: Grasslands (S1 E5). Documentary about nature. USA, 2023. S1, Ep5
programme.desc: 2023 г. Год: 2023. Страна: JAV. Год: 2023. S1, Ep5 «Evolution Earth»…Explore one of Earth's most vital but overlooked habitats and learn how grasslands could slow climate change by soaking up more carbon than forests do. Meet key species, such as bison and pumas, that could restore this resource and heal our planetEvolution Earth embarks on a global expedition to reveal the animals keeping pace with a planet changing at superspeed. Heading out across the globe to distant wilds and modern urban environments, five episodes track how animals are moving, using ingenuity to adapt their behavior, and even evolving in unexpected ways. At the front lines of this rapid change are the scientists, filmmakers and local communities recording the animals' stories. We follow heart-warming tales of resilience that redefine our understanding of evolution, and hint at how nature can show us a path towards a sustainable future for Planet Earth. The series is narrated by Dr. Shane Campbell-Staton, who guides us through each episode in an intimate narrative style, drawing on his background as an evolutionary biologistDirector: Charlotte LathaneCast: Shane Campbell-Staton

programme.title: Deep in the Heart. Documentary about nature. USA, 2022
programme.desc: 2022 г. Год: 2022. Страна: JAV. Год: 2022. «Deep in the Heart. A Texas Wildlife Story»…Take a journey through the eyes of catfish, ocelots, and other native creatures with narrator Matthew McConaughey. Celebrate the Lone Star State's landscapes and wildlife, and learn how crucial conservation efforts can save Texas' unique habitatsDirector: Ben MastersCast: Matthew McConaughey

programme.title: Big Cat Country: Punks on the Run (S1 E3). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Anglija, 2020. S1, Ep3
programme.desc: 2020 г. Год: 2020. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2020. S1, Ep3 «Big Cat Country»…The lions of the Nomad pride rampage deep into the heart of the MK pride's territory, scattering its members and coming dangerously close to the five new MK cubs. Meanwhile, the Hollywoods are recovering, and Ava's survival skills are still intactBig Cat Country is a documentary series revolving around two neighbouring lion prides of the great rift valley, in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Wildlife film-makers Nathan Pilcher and Sam Davies are in the middle of the action. Watch the big cats facing the greatest challenge of their lives, fighting for the hunting territory and their place in the sun, looking for mates and struggling for their lives, bonding together in order to survive and defend themselvesDirector: Beth BrooksCast: Irvine Iqbal

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School: Wine's New Friend (S2 E5). Documentary about nature. England, 2019. S2, Ep5
programme.desc: 2019 г. Год: 2019. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2019. S2, Ep5 «Orangutan Jungle School»…Join two seriously ill orangutans in the medical clinic, where Erik's head infection is causing concern and fourteen-year-old Mia's life depends on a blood transfusion. Outside the clinic, the infants find a secret treat hidden inside a rubber treeCaptivating documentary series that follows the work of the Nyaru Menteng Orangutan Rescue Centre in Borneo, Indonesia, which is the largest orangutan rehabilitation centre in the world. People who work here are dedicated to rescuing orangutans that have been displaced from their habitat or kept as illegal pets, and they do their best to help them adjust and teach them the skills necessary to survive on their own when they return to the jungle. Hear some incredible stories and follow the antics, triumphs and tragedies of a group of orphaned orangutans as they go through «Orangutan Jungle School»Director: Judith CurranCast: Rebecca Parr

programme.title: Shark Squad: Bimini Sharklab (S1 E2). Documentary about nature. Canada, 2018. S1, Ep2
programme.desc: 2018 г. Год: 2018. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2018. S1, Ep2 «Shark Squad»…Travel to a remote part of the Bahamas to unlock shark secrets. Do they make friends? Where do they give birth? Are some bolder than others? The answers may help protect these supreme predators for generations to comeNot since the trio of Chief Brody, Matt Hooper and Quint have we seen a group of experts take on one of the ocean's most feared hunters; sharks. The enthusiastic shark-lovers risk their lives for the sake of science, as they explore the migration, behaviours and diets of these underwater apex predators. With many shark species threatened by human activities, it's vital that we learn more about these prehistoric animals, with many being descendants from the Jurassic period. The team head to Guadalupe and the Bahamas, using ultrasonic tagging equipment to track Great Whites and Tiger sharksDirector: Dan Hughes

programme.desc: Jack, a coastal diamondback python, was struck by a tractor and requires surgery. Prickles the Echidna has been hit by a car and Dr. Bree is working to put his sprained leg back into place. Australia

programme.title: d/f Raccoons: Survival Geniuses
programme.desc: Known for their curiosity and remarkable intelligence, raccoons become true survivalists. At a time when many species of animals are facing the threat of extinction, raccoons are experiencing a real boom, expanding their territories. Despite their cute appearance, they have an exceptional temperament and the ability to overcome any challenge. United Kingdom

programme.title: d/s Symbols of wildlife (Antelopes)
programme.desc: The elephant, rhinoceros and hippopotamus are the largest land mammals on earth. They are different from each other and do not belong to the same family, but they have one thing in common: these vegetarian giants are not ruminants. France

programme.title: Not the heavenly life of the Garden of Eden. 2 s.
programme.desc: The Singapore Botanic Garden is the only tropical garden recognized by UNESCO as a World Heritage Site. There is an incredible variety of tropical flora and fauna here. Together with the local inhabitants, we will spend a year of our lives and see the dramatic life of wild nature hidden from prying eyes. Singapore

programme.title: d/f Ice Kingdom of the Snow Leopard
programme.desc: In a secret valley, in the heart of the Tibetan Plateau, lives a mythical and fascinating animal - the snow leopard. Two photographer brothers are on his trail. The extreme conditions they face do not break their determination to photograph this wary predator.

programme.title: d/s Natural family ties (New guys on the block)
programme.desc: Find out what it's like to grow up in the animal kingdom and discover the first challenges these little creatures face. Get familiar with the difficulties and dangers that await them. Dir.: Juan Luis Santos. Spain

programme.title: d/f Italy. Through the wilderness (Sardinia: the lost world of Terrenia)
programme.desc: This episode takes a new and intimate look at the extraordinary animals of the Mediterranean's second largest island, focusing on the vultures, endemic red deer and large cetaceans found off the island's west coast

programme.title: d/s Kingdom of the Giant Panda (Birth of a Giant)
programme.desc: Unique footage of the birth of a giant panda cub! France

programme.title: t/s Wild Killers (Disguise)
programme.desc: In the wild it is survival of the fittest, and each creature has its own set of skills and weapons. Viewers will get to know poisonous spiders, fast snakes, camouflaged cuttlefish, ferocious sharks and other deadly animals. This exciting journey will reveal the secrets of the hunters at the top of the food chain. Dir.: Paul Dean. USA

programme.title: d/s Wild Animals of Europe (Wild World of the Loire)
programme.desc: This film tells about one of the last wild rivers in nature and the inhabitants inhabiting its banks and waters. France

programme.title: d/s Planet Ocean
programme.desc: Man lives on land, but for a long time he has been trying to conquer the ocean. What treasures does the depth contain? Humanity is developing new ways to conquer the elements. You'll discover a variety of marine life, explore the most remote corners of the oceans, and learn how water shapes the climate, influences our daily lives, and plays a key role in maintaining balance on Earth. Dir.: Yann Arthus-Bertrand, Michael Pitiot. France, 2012, documentary

programme.title: d/f Normandy. An earth created by people and nature. Top view
programme.desc: The Normandy region is located in northwestern France. There are many apple plantations and farms here. Normandy is also famous for its dairy industry: the region produces Camembert, Livavreau and Pont-l'Evêque cheeses. Normandy is one of the wonders of France, which is why a team of researchers led by Olivier Chiabodeau is sent here. The region is located along the English Channel and amazes with its marine beauty. The lands of Normandy became excellent pastures for cows and a place where horses were bred and ridden. This is a rare place in Europe where wildlife coexists perfectly with agriculture

programme.title: d/f Normandy: between sky and sea
programme.desc: The film is dedicated to the unique and fragile ecosystem of the rocky Cape Carteret in Normandy. After human activity has damaged the local fauna, two iconic predators - the peregrine falcon (a tireless hunter) and the raven (distinguished by special intelligence) - are gradually reclaiming these wild spaces. A kind of confrontation over territory is unfolding between them. France

programme.title: d/s World of Wildlife (The Strongest)
programme.desc: Mighty grizzly bears. Tiny strong ants. A swift, inimitable throw of a crocodile. Indestructible armor of the rhinoceros beetle. Who will be called the strongest on our planet? USA

programme.title: d/s World of Wildlife (Fastest)
programme.desc: Do you know which animal is the fastest? In this series, we'll meet authentic wildlife walkers: kangaroo, cheetah, zebra and bald eagle. USA

programme.title: d/s The most dangerous animals (Africa)
programme.desc: The wilds of Africa are the stage on which many species participate in the eternal dance of life and death. USA

programme.title: d/s Strategies in the wild (Masters of attack)
programme.desc: Ideal hunters: dolphin traps, crocodiles patience, spider skills. What incredible abilities help predators survive. Dir.: Max Serio, Bettina Dalton. Czech Republic, USA

programme.title: d/f Southern Winter
programme.desc: Winter in the south of the Iberian Peninsula is a time of abundance and harmony. Migratory birds find refuge in the mild climate to escape the cold, and local nature continues to thrive. Water spaces, forests and meadows become the stage for amazing natural processes, creating a paradise for wildlife and explorers of this region

programme.title: d/s On the brink of extinction (Mediterranean)
programme.desc: Every day, about 200 species of plants and animals leave the planet, accelerating the process of the sixth mass extinction. It is important to act to preserve biodiversity by protecting the natural centers of life that are located in different parts of the world. This project shows how life on Earth depends on the preservation of these ecosystems. United Kingdom

programme.title: d/s Water world of Komodo Island (Mysterious cave and sunken ship)
programme.desc: Explore Komodo Island, a unique ecosystem that will take you back 100 million years. You will see huge Komodo dragons, a variety of sharks and rays, sea turtles and dolphins. Hidden in the sunken cave is the mystery of Ebu-gogo, a mysterious creature that scientists still cannot solve. Director: Andrzej Misiuk. Germany

programme.title: Wildlife Story (The Lost Land of Tigers and Leopards)
programme.desc: The history of wildlife is full of amazing and exciting moments. One of the saddest chapters in this story is the lost land of tigers and leopards. South Korea

programme.title: d/f Sharp fangs of Savannah
programme.desc: We will look into the secret life of savannah predators and reveal the secrets of their hunting. You will see how these animals use instincts and strategy to hunt their prey. Not only by strength, but also by intelligence, dexterity and group tactics, predators hunt in the most brutal conditions of the savannah. France

programme.title: x/f Fire Fox
programme.desc: The wind was born the weakest fox in the family. By chance, it was he who survived the bear attack. He managed to survive his first winter and win the love of the beautiful Lava. But in the spring they return - the bears. The horror of his old enemy leads Vetra to a fatal mistake. Now, in order to save his children and return Lava, he must defeat his fear and the most formidable predator of Kamchatka. Director: Dmitry Shpilenok. Russia, 2024, drama, documentary, adventure, for the whole family

programme.title: d/f Transformation into a butterfly
programme.desc: The documentary takes you on a unique journey following a tiny caterpillar whose life is suddenly turned upside down by a hurricane. Left without a home, she must return to her lemon tree in just three days to complete the magical transformation. Every step she takes is a real feat, and meetings with other inhabitants of the forest become a test of strength and resourcefulness. France

programme.title: d/s Evolution (Study)
programme.desc: In the first stage of his journey, Patrick explores how life evolved. From gravity-defying giraffes to radiation-resistant mushrooms. Also, can nature help us explore worlds beyond planet Earth? Dir.: Chris Baron. USA, Singapore

programme.title: THE UNXPLAINED WITH WILLIAM SHATNER S3 EP21
programme.desc: Trên khắp thế giới đều bị cấm 'tam giác' - những khu vực bí ẩn nơi tàu, máy bay và con người đi vào rồi biến mất. Chúng được tìm thấy ở Bermuda, Alaska, Nhật Bản và những nơi khác. Nhưng tại sao?

programme.title: SWAMP PEOPLE S15 EP15
programme.desc: Chỉ còn ba ngày nữa là hết mùa, đợt không khí lạnh khiến đàn cá sấu phải ẩn náu. Willie và Little Willie lần đầu tiên chia tay nhau để có thêm mối quan hệ và Willie bé nhỏ cảm thấy áp lực.

programme.title: THE UNBELIEVABLE WITH DAN AYKROYD S1 EP10
programme.desc: Xương người là 'thần dược' chữa bệnh gút? Xác ướp sống bị chôn sống? Một cách giảm cân thực sự kỳ lạ của người Victoria - bằng sán dây? Mặt xa lạ của bản chất con người được bộc lộ trong những nghi lễ này.

programme.title: THE CURSE OF OAK ISLAND S12 EP22
programme.desc: Radar xuyên mặt đất mới phát hiện ra bằng chứng về nhiều công trình hơn trong đầm lầy và khi mùa đông đến gần, nhóm cùng nhau lên một kế hoạch táo bạo để lần đầu tiên đi vào Kênh Giải pháp.

programme.title: HISTORY'S GREATEST ESCAPES WITH MORGAN FREEMAN S2 EP11
programme.desc: Một nghệ sĩ vượt ngục suốt đời, Forrest Tucker, cuối cùng phải vào nhà tù San Quentin. Nhưng dù tuổi đã cao, ông vẫn cố gắng thực hiện một trong những vụ vượt ngục táo bạo nhất mọi thời đại.

programme.title: MOUNTAIN MEN S13 EP10
programme.desc: Lauro tiếp tục nhiệm vụ hoàn thành Iditarod xuyên qua nội địa Alaska. Bret và Ivy truy đuổi một con gấu ở địa hình dốc nguy hiểm. Daniel đặt bẫy sói để bảo vệ đàn hươu.

programme.title: QUAN VÂN TRƯỜNG - THE LOST BLADESMAN
programme.desc: Một cuộc phiêu lưu lịch sử hoành tráng lấy bối cảnh thời kỳ hỗn loạn của Tam Quốc. Tào Tháo cố gắng chiêu mộ Quan Vũ vào lực lượng của mình, nhưng Quan trung thành với người anh em kết nghĩa Lưu Bị, cũng là kẻ thù của Tào Tháo. Khi Quan cố gắng giải cứu vợ lẽ của Lưu Bị khỏi tay Tào Tháo, anh ta buộc phải chiến đấu để vượt qua. Liệu cuối cùng anh ấy có thể thành công?

programme.title: BIỆT ĐỘI BÔNG HỒNG THÉP - IRON SQUAD W
programme.desc: Mùa thứ tư của chương trình sinh tồn quân sự Hàn Quốc này sẽ quyết định nữ quân nhân ưu tú nhất. Nó tập hợp sáu đơn vị Lực lượng Đặc biệt để cạnh tranh trong các nhiệm vụ đầy thử thách trên bộ, trên biển và trên không. Những nữ quân nhân dự bị hàng đầu thành lập các đội gồm bốn người để thi đấu với nhau. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ chiến đấu đến cùng trước sáu người dẫn chương trình nổi tiếng!

programme.title: HÀNG LONG ĐẠI SƯ: CHÚ MA LONG - DRAGON MASTER: DRAGON SPELL
programme.desc: Vua Rồng bị Long Master phong ấn suốt 500 năm, và con gái của ông phải du hành ngược thời gian về 500 năm trước để giết Long Master, nhằm đảo ngược hành động. Cô không hề biết rằng Long Vương và Long Chủ là bạn thân hồi đó…

programme.title: SỐNG SÓT Ở ĐÔNG L.A. - LIVE AND DIE IN EAST LA
programme.desc: Sau khi chữa trị cho một cậu bé bị thương trong một vụ tông xe rồi bỏ chạy, bác sĩ cấp cứu Attila bị lôi kéo vào cuộc xung đột thế giới ngầm ở Đông L.A. Cậu bé là con trai của một tên trùm tội phạm và “tai nạn” là sự trả thù của băng đảng. Để cứu em gái khỏi nhà tù, Attila trở thành người vận chuyển ma túy, châm ngòi cho một cuộc chiến băng đảng buộc cô phải đưa ra lựa chọn bi thảm.

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!

programme.title: QUAN VÂN TRƯỜNG - THE LOST BLADESMAN
programme.desc: Một cuộc phiêu lưu lịch sử hoành tráng lấy bối cảnh thời kỳ hỗn loạn của Tam Quốc. programme.title: ĐẶC VỤ VÔ HÌNH - THE GREY MEN
programme.desc: Sĩ quan cảnh sát Hồng Kông Ah Shan bí mật vào tù để lấy lòng tin của tên tội phạm Tian và tìm kiếm bằng chứng chống lại băng đảng của hắn. Sau khi được thả, Shan giúp Tian nổi lên trong băng đảng và trở thành ông chủ mới. Tuy nhiên, khi Shan trấn áp băng nhóm này, anh phát hiện ra một bí mật gây sốc về Tian...

programme.title: KỲ NGHỈ CỦA ĐẤNG MÀY RÂU - THE ULTIMATE BROCATION
programme.desc: Một chương trình thực tế vui nhộn kể về bốn nam nhân vật nổi tiếng đến từ các quốc gia khác nhau trong một kỳ nghỉ giả tưởng được đài thọ toàn bộ chi phí ở Hồng Kông, được thiết kế riêng cho các “anh em”!

programme.title: CỖ MÁY CHIẾN ĐẤU - THE FIGHT MACHINE
programme.desc: Hai chàng trai trẻ người Canada đến từ những thế giới hoàn toàn khác nhau đang bị mắc kẹt trong một cuộc sống ngoài tầm kiểm soát của anh. Khi họ bị kéo vào vòng chiến đấu tay không không thể tha thứ dưới lòng đất, sự va chạm của họ đã khơi dậy một hành trình báo thù, trả thù và khám phá bản thân tàn bạo.
